svg.aria-label: Level 01, Hamieverse (2025 - now): Backend for a live multiplayer card game. Quest: Keep a live card game fair while players disconnect, retry and race each other. Build: An event-driven mission rules engine run from a dashboard, plus server-owned PvP reconnects and turn timers. Boss fight: No reward paid twice: hardening an idempotent grant, transaction, invoice and entitlement pipeline. Tech: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, AWS.
